data.name: Qanawaat
data.gender_notes: Qanawaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'qanawat' meaning 'a gentle breeze' or 'a delicate flower'. This name evokes images of softness, grace, and elegance. It is a beautiful choice for a little girl who embodies these qualities. The name Qanawaat carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qanawaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of Allah's mercy and love.
data.etymology: Qanawaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qanawaat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
